services.name: Tween Yoga
services.desc: Yoga- Focused on fluidity with creative flowing sequences geared to open and strengthen the entire body. services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: What is the difference between personal training and group classes? Personal training is an individualized and educated approach to resistance training. The workouts are customized for the individual, their goals, lifestyle needs, and experience level. The main difference between personal training and group classes is that personal training is a private/semi-private experience that is 100% tailored to the client and is goal-specific to each person’s needs. How often should I see a personal trainer? This will depend on the client’s desire, their availability, and the trainer’s availability, but most people benefit from 1-3 sessions per week.
